# Third-party assets

Files here are used as they came: they are not generated by the Blender
build (`Tools/Blender/build_assets.py`) and are never baked. Size, facing
and pose are set by the level file that uses them. This folder ships with
the game, so the credits go with it.

| File | What | Author | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `old_man_psx.glb` | "old man psx": rigged character (Mixamo skin), one clip (a dance); the street's shrine keeper, held on frame 0 | petya-petyavich | [sketchfab](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/old-man-psx-dc42fa861cd645f489be5c9b3d2076fb) | [CC BY 4.0](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) |
